environment.audit_boundary: Named event and SUMMARY receipts checked directly. Owner froze complete current source inventories and audited actual source messages; this publication does not rescan private REQUEST prefixes or model answers.

input.primary_source_basis: Owner-read Intel manual revision 093 notes and annex, actual complete normal assembly, and direct declaring API bodies. Primary sources, not model factual authority.
input.round2: Same complete inputs plus each role own earlier complete answer and named diagnosis only; no cross-answer or owner conditional-case feed.
input.not_supplied: No captured control/status state or authenticated multiplier bytes; no new interface proposal, implementation, Test, or oracle.

HTTP.scope: Exact selected client intervals only, not global service state or sustained 12-16 requests.

adoption.three_complete_answers: Whole conclusions rejected after source and primary-document review: false numerical precision/overflow claims, incorrect exact-tiny underflow behavior, and updating a destination despite a fault. Source-confirmed partial facts remain separate from whole approval.
adoption.rounding_round2: Length 5000; entire incomplete answer discarded unread, with no fragments adopted. This is an output-budget result, not an additional semantic rejection.
adoption.owner_deliverable: Owner-authored research documentation and six conditional cases frozen before first answer reading; 23 finite exact rational/integer relations support arithmetic only.

validation.limits: No instruction execution, control/status flag behavior, CPU/OS qualification, executable API correctness, Native/Game authority, runtime deployment, or performance validation.

cost.marker_boundary: Initial primary/source work preceded PREP. REVIEW marker followed initial complete first-answer reading, so preceding review time is unknown. These wall markers do not establish exclusive active labor.
cost.owner_errors: Initial Windows path-spelling comparison falsely rejected equal source hashes and was corrected before POST; later direct primary-URL tool errors recovered from existing cached official references. Neither is model or Java failure.

formal.original_source_cutoff: Documentation ready for the sole formal writer; original pending records unchanged.

later_source_clarification: A later restricted-mask primary-source annex is an owner source clarification, not a fifth model task or a new software/CPU validation.
